newsitem.title: USA: Plains 1996 proved oil and gas reserves up.
newsitem.headline: Plains 1996 proved oil and gas reserves up.

text.p: Plains Resources Inc said Thursday that 1996 proved oil and natural gas reserve volumes increased 20 percent to 122 million barrels of oil equivalent as compared with 102 million barrels at year-end 1995.

The company said crude oil volumes totaled 95 percent of total equivalent reserve volumes and about 74 percent of the company's proved reserve volumes were classified as proved developed at year-end 1996.

Plains Resources said the pretax net present value (discounted at 10 percent) of its proved oil and gas reserves increased by 109 percent, totaling $765 million for the 1996 period, about $400 million higher than 1995's comparable value of $367 million.

The company said independent engineers estimated pretax future net revenues from the company's year-end 1996 proved oil and gas reserves at $1.6 billion, more than double the $713 million recorded last year.

The company said the improvement in reserve value was fueled by an increase in crude oil volumes and improved unit operating margins as a result of higher crude oil prices and reduced production expenses.
